title: Apex Launches Prediction Markets Platform Powered by Kalshi
excerpt: Tastytrade is the first firm to sign on, but Apex says it is seeing demand from wealth managers and RIAs.
content_html:
Diana Britton

Thu, August 13, 2026 at 3:00 AM PDT 2 min read

You can find original article here WealthManagement. Subscribe to our free daily WealthManagement newsletters.

Apex Fintech Solutions has launched a prediction markets platform, with an API that gives firms access to market flow from prediction market exchange Kalshi.

Tastytrade, a platform for active traders, is the first firm on the platform, but Apex expects to onboard others in the future, including wealth management firms and registered investment advisors.

With the new platform, Apex handles all Futures Commission Merchant operations, clearing, segregated custody and account management, so firms don't have to build their own FCM infrastructure or direct exchange connectivity. Kalshi provides the regulated marketplace and event contract offerings, and 24/7 trading access.

Travis McGhee, global head of digital markets at Apex Fintech Solutions, said the firm has seen an increase over the last 18 months in inbound inquiries and demand for access to prediction markets across all categories, including sports, politics and cultural events. That includes demand from wealth management clients.

"I view prediction markets as simply another asset class," he said. "So our connectivity to those RIAs and wealth advisors, those APIs and pipes that we have built for them, is that plug and play technology where if an RIA or a wealth advisor has interest in the prediction markets and demand from their client base to be able to access those, that we could simply make that API connection and enable that product for that respective wealth manager or RIA no different than we would any other asset class."

For advisors to use prediction markets with their clients, they would establish themselves as an "introducing broker," a registration with the National Futures Association and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

McGhee said there aren't many wealth management firms currently active in prediction markets, but noted there is interest.

"We are starting to receive inbound inquiries from RIAs, from wealth and asset managers asking and inquiring, 'How does this market work? What does it look like? What are you seeing on demand on the broker/dealer side? Where do you see this space going in terms of regulation? Where do you see these contracts evolving?'"

Apex Fintech Solutions 推出了一个预测市场平台，该平台具有 API，使公司能够访问来自预测市场交易所 Kalshi 的市场流量。

Tastytrade 是一个面向活跃交易者的平台，是该平台上的第一家公司，但 Apex 预计未来还会加入其他公司，包括财富管理公司和注册投资顾问。

借助新平台，Apex 可以处理所有期货经纪商业务、清算、独立托管和账户管理，因此公司无需构建自己的 FCM 基础设施或直接交易所连接。 Kalshi 提供受监管的市场和活动合约产品以及 24/7 交易访问。

Apex Fintech Solutions 数字市场全球主管 Travis McGhee 表示，过去 18 个月，该公司发现所有类别（包括体育、政治和文化活动）的入站查询和进入预测市场的需求有所增加。 这包括财富管理客户的需求。

“我认为预测市场只是另一种资产类别，”他说。 “因此，我们与这些 RIA 和财富顾问的连接，即我们为他们构建的 API 和管道，是一种即插即用的技术，如果 RIA 或财富顾问对预测市场感兴趣并且他们的客户群要求能够访问这些市场，我们可以简单地建立 API 连接并为相应的财富管理机构或 RIA 启用该产品，与我们为任何其他资产类别提供的产品没有什么不同。”

对于与客户一起使用预测市场的顾问来说，他们将自己定位为“介绍经纪人”，即在国家期货协会和商品期货交易委员会注册。

麦吉表示，目前活跃在预测市场的财富管理公司并不多，但他指出人们对此很感兴趣。

“我们开始收到来自 RIA、财富和资产管理者的入站询问，‘这个市场是如何运作的？ 它看起来像什么？ 您对经纪商/交易商方面的需求有何看法？ 您认为这个领域在监管方面将走向何方？ 您认为这些合同在哪里演变？”
